name: Monochrome
oneLiner: a designer's grey canvas: dot grid, giant soft black asterisks, a cursor dragging dashed selection boxes, and real photographic 3D props as the only colour
bestFor: founder-led brands, agencies, services and personal brands with a sharp one-sentence pitch; anything that should feel editorial, confident and crafted; 9:16 social
motion: cursor-drawn selection boxes with words popping inside (back.out(2) with a blur-in), asterisk and dark-band wipes, props that drop and swing, a type run, curtains closing at an angle; the asterisks turn the whole film
ground: light grey #E8E8E8 to #D9D9D9 with a 30px dot grid and multiply grain

sound.ui: a click as the cursor starts each box, a pop on each headline and prop, a whoosh on every wipe, one tick per word in the type run, one hit when the curtains close
